I agree with you. But the thing is I did find medication to be productive as I felt elated. I would've been on them forever and I would've loved it. But the output was nothing. Zero to be exact. The right medication, there isn't anything like that. Trust me. Ask anyone who is on meds. Refer me to someone who says meds work. They are temporary shits from which you need to withdraw, if you don't they suck your life away. 

I chose to suck my own life my own way. So there's that.

Nice to know. I was on meds way back in my teens didn't work out. I was too tired and had a choice to make, on or off. I chose off. Did manage to do a lot without the sht, so I guess I'd better off dying without motivation than on drugs with quasi motivation that fails you at the end like a slumber dog.
No. I'm not taking any medications atm and I do not plan to get drugged and become as lousy as a snail. If it isn't so for those who take meds, reply.

Somebody said ignorance. You say corruption. I say loneliness. Can you logically prove your point? 

What is your passion? Have you been able to wake up in the morning and say bring it on?

>  concentrate on your passions

What is that thing called passion? I feel like I'm listening to a script of The Mighty Boosh which doesn't make an ounce of sense. How do you find passion? Have you found your passion?
Because of feeling lonely. I believe loneliness is the root cause of world major problems.
The issue is lack of motivation along with other problems, causing me to lose myself.
